### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Models/ValueSource.cs
################################################################################

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Models;

public enum ValueSource
{

    Literal,

    SecretServer
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Models/LoginStep.cs
################################################################################

using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Models;

public sealed class LoginStep
{

    public StepType Type { get; set; }

    public string? Description { get; set; }

    public string? Selector { get; set; }

    public string? Value { get; set; }

    public ValueSource ValueType { get; set; } = ValueSource.Literal;

    public string? Url { get; set; }

    public string? Text { get; set; }

    public SelectBy? SelectBy { get; set; }

    public int? TimeoutMs { get; set; }

    public bool Optional { get; set; }

    [JsonIgnore]
    public bool IsSecret => Type is StepType.Fill && (Selector?.Contains("pass", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true);

    public override string ToString()
    {
        var label = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Description) ? Type.ToString() : $"{Type} — {Description}";
        return label;
    }
}

### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Models/MonitorOptions.cs
################################################################################

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Models;

public sealed class MonitorOptions
{

    public string Browser { get; set; } = "edge";

    public bool Headless { get; set; } = true;

    public int SlowMoMs { get; set; }

    public int DefaultTimeoutMs { get; set; } = 15000;

    public bool FailOnHttpError { get; set; } = true;

    public bool FailOnBlankPage { get; set; } = true;

    public bool ScreenshotOnFailure { get; set; } = true;

    public string ArtifactsDirectory { get; set; } = "artifacts";

    public int MaxParallelism { get; set; } = 1;

    public string SitesFile { get; set; } = "sites.json";

    public EmailOptions Email { get; set; } = new();

    public SecretServerOptions SecretServer { get; set; } = new();
}

public sealed class SecretServerOptions
{

    public string BaseUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string ApiPathPrefix { get; set; } = "winauthwebservices/api/v1";

    public string TokenFieldSlug { get; set; } = "apiKey";

    public bool Base64Encoded { get; set; } = true;

    public int TimeoutMs { get; set; } = 15000;
}

public sealed class EmailOptions
{

    public bool Enabled { get; set; }

    public bool OnlyOnFailure { get; set; } = true;

    public string SmtpHost { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int SmtpPort { get; set; } = 587;

    public bool UseStartTls { get; set; } = true;

    public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string From { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public List<string> To { get; set; } = new();

    public string SubjectPrefix { get; set; } = "[WebLoginMonitor]";
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Services/SecretServerClient.cs
################################################################################

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using NLog;
using WebLoginMonitor.Models;

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Services;

public sealed class SecretServerClient : IDisposable
{
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Json = new() { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };

    private readonly HttpClient _http;
    private readonly SecretServerOptions _options;
    private readonly ILogger _log;
    private readonly string _apiBase;

    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Lazy<Task<string>>> _cache =
        new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public SecretServerClient(SecretServerOptions options, ILogger log)
    {
        _options = options;
        _log = log;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(options.BaseUrl))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "Monitor.SecretServer.BaseUrl n'est pas configuré : impossible de contacter Secret Server.");

        var handler = new HttpClientHandler
        {
            UseDefaultCredentials = true,
            PreAuthenticate = true
        };
        _http = new HttpClient(handler) { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(options.TimeoutMs) };
        _apiBase = $"{options.BaseUrl.TrimEnd('/')}/{options.ApiPathPrefix.Trim('/')}";

        _log.Debug("Secret Server : API = {Api} (champ '{Slug}', base64={B64})",
            _apiBase, options.TokenFieldSlug, options.Base64Encoded);
    }

    public Task<string> GetSecretAsync(string secretName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secretName))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "Un secret Secret Server sans nom ('value') a été demandé.");

        return _cache.GetOrAdd(secretName, name => new Lazy<Task<string>>(() => FetchAsync(name))).Value;
    }

    private async Task<string> FetchAsync(string secretName)
    {
        var id = await FindSecretIdAsync(secretName);
        var raw = await ReadFieldAsync(id, _options.TokenFieldSlug);

        if (!_options.Base64Encoded)
            return raw;

        try
        {
            return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(raw));
        }
        catch (FormatException ex)
        {

            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Le champ '{_options.TokenFieldSlug}' du secret '{secretName}' n'est pas un base64 valide " +
                "(Base64Encoded=true). Vérifiez le contenu du secret ou passez Base64Encoded à false.", ex);
        }
    }

    private async Task<int> FindSecretIdAsync(string secretName)
    {
        var url = $"{_apiBase}/secrets?filter.searchField=name&filter.searchText={Uri.EscapeDataString(secretName)}";
        using var resp = await _http.GetAsync(url);
        if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Secret Server : la recherche du secret '{secretName}' a échoué (HTTP {(int)resp.StatusCode} {resp.ReasonPhrase}).");

        var payload = await resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<SearchResponse>(Json)
                      ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(
                          $"Secret Server : réponse de recherche illisible pour '{secretName}'.");

        var matches = payload.Records
            .Where(r => string.Equals(r.Name, secretName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .ToList();

        if (matches.Count == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Secret Server : aucun secret nommé exactement '{secretName}' " +
                $"({payload.Records.Count} résultat(s) approchant(s) ignoré(s)).");
        if (matches.Count > 1)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Secret Server : {matches.Count} secrets portent le nom '{secretName}'. Rendez-le unique.");

        return matches[0].Id;
    }

    private async Task<string> ReadFieldAsync(int secretId, string slug)
    {
        var url = $"{_apiBase}/secrets/{secretId}/fields/{Uri.EscapeDataString(slug)}";
        using var resp = await _http.GetAsync(url);
        if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Secret Server : lecture du champ '{slug}' (secret #{secretId}) a échoué " +
                $"(HTTP {(int)resp.StatusCode} {resp.ReasonPhrase}).");

        var body = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        try
        {
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<string>(body) ?? body;
        }
        catch (JsonException)
        {
            return body;
        }
    }

    public void Dispose() => _http.Dispose();

    private sealed class SearchResponse
    {
        public List<SecretSummary> Records { get; set; } = new();
    }

    private sealed class SecretSummary
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Services/StepExecutor.cs
################################################################################

using Microsoft.Playwright;
using NLog;
using WebLoginMonitor.Models;

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Services;

public sealed class StepExecutor
{
    private readonly int _defaultTimeoutMs;
    private readonly bool _failOnHttpError;
    private readonly ILogger _log;
    private readonly SecretServerClient? _secretServer;

    public StepExecutor(int defaultTimeoutMs, bool failOnHttpError, ILogger log, SecretServerClient? secretServer = null)
    {
        _defaultTimeoutMs = defaultTimeoutMs;
        _failOnHttpError = failOnHttpError;
        _log = log;
        _secretServer = secretServer;
    }

    public async Task ExecuteAsync(IPage page, LoginStep step)
    {
        float timeout = step.TimeoutMs ?? _defaultTimeoutMs;
        var value = await ResolveValueAsync(step);
        var url = SecretResolver.Resolve(step.Url);

        _log.Debug("{Step}", step.ToString());

        switch (step.Type)
        {
            case StepType.Goto:
            {
                var response = await page.GotoAsync(
                    RequireUrl(url, step),
                    new PageGotoOptions { Timeout = timeout, WaitUntil = WaitUntilState.Load });
                if (_failOnHttpError && response is not null && response.Status >= 400)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Statut HTTP {response.Status} ({response.StatusText}) sur {url}");
                break;
            }

            case StepType.Fill:
                await page.FillAsync(
                    RequireSelector(step),
                    value ?? string.Empty,
                    new PageFillOptions { Timeout = timeout });
                break;

            case StepType.Click:
                await page.ClickAsync(
                    RequireSelector(step),
                    new PageClickOptions { Timeout = timeout });
                break;

            case StepType.Press:
                await page.PressAsync(
                    RequireSelector(step),
                    RequireValue(value, step, "touche clavier"),
                    new PagePressOptions { Timeout = timeout });
                break;

            case StepType.SelectOption:
            {
                var selector = RequireSelector(step);
                var option = RequireValue(value, step, "valeur d'option");
                var selectOpts = new PageSelectOptionOptions { Timeout = timeout };
                switch (step.SelectBy ?? SelectBy.Value)
                {
                    case SelectBy.Label:
                        await page.SelectOptionAsync(selector, new SelectOptionValue { Label = option }, selectOpts);
                        break;
                    case SelectBy.Index:
                        if (!int.TryParse(option, out var index))
                            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                                $"L'étape '{step}' : 'value' doit être un entier quand selectBy = Index.");
                        await page.SelectOptionAsync(selector, new SelectOptionValue { Index = index }, selectOpts);
                        break;
                    default:
                        await page.SelectOptionAsync(selector, new[] { option }, selectOpts);
                        break;
                }
                break;
            }

            case StepType.WaitForSelector:
                await page.WaitForSelectorAsync(
                    RequireSelector(step),
                    new PageWaitForSelectorOptions { Timeout = timeout, State = WaitForSelectorState.Visible });
                break;

            case StepType.WaitForUrl:
                await page.WaitForURLAsync(
                    RequireUrl(url, step),
                    new PageWaitForURLOptions { Timeout = timeout });
                break;

            case StepType.WaitForTimeout:
                await page.WaitForTimeoutAsync(timeout);
                break;

            case StepType.ExpectVisible:
                await Assertions.Expect(page.Locator(RequireSelector(step)))
                    .ToBeVisibleAsync(new LocatorAssertionsToBeVisibleOptions { Timeout = timeout });
                break;

            case StepType.ExpectText:
                await Assertions.Expect(page.Locator(RequireSelector(step)))
                    .ToContainTextAsync(
                        RequireValue(step.Text, step, "texte attendu"),
                        new LocatorAssertionsToContainTextOptions { Timeout = timeout });
                break;

            case StepType.ExpectUrl:
                await Assertions.Expect(page)
                    .ToHaveURLAsync(RequireUrl(url, step), new PageAssertionsToHaveURLOptions { Timeout = timeout });
                break;

            case StepType.ExpectNotBlank:
                if (await PageChecks.IsBlankAsync(page))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("La page est blanche (aucun contenu visible).");
                break;

            default:
                throw new NotSupportedException($"Type d'étape non pris en charge : {step.Type}");
        }
    }

    private async Task<string?> ResolveValueAsync(LoginStep step)
    {
        if (step.ValueType == ValueSource.SecretServer)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(step.Value))
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"L'étape '{step}' (valueType=SecretServer) requiert 'value' = nom du secret.");
            if (_secretServer is null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"L'étape '{step}' référence un secret Secret Server mais 'Monitor.SecretServer.BaseUrl' " +
                    "n'est pas configuré.");
            return await _secretServer.GetSecretAsync(step.Value);
        }

        return SecretResolver.Resolve(step.Value);
    }

    private static string RequireSelector(LoginStep step) =>
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(step.Selector)
            ? step.Selector
            : throw new InvalidOperationException($"L'étape '{step}' requiert un 'selector'.");

    private static string RequireUrl(string? url, LoginStep step) =>
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url)
            ? url
            : throw new InvalidOperationException($"L'étape '{step}' requiert une 'url'.");

    private static string RequireValue(string? value, LoginStep step, string what) =>
        !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)
            ? value
            : throw new InvalidOperationException($"L'étape '{step}' requiert une valeur ({what}).");
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Services/SiteRunner.cs
################################################################################

using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.Playwright;
using NLog;
using WebLoginMonitor.Models;

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Services;

public sealed class SiteRunner
{
    private readonly IBrowser _browser;
    private readonly MonitorOptions _options;
    private readonly SecretServerClient? _secretServer;
    private readonly ILogger _log = LogManager.GetCurrentClassLogger();
    private readonly ILogger _results = LogManager.GetLogger("Results");

    public SiteRunner(IBrowser browser, MonitorOptions options, SecretServerClient? secretServer = null)
    {
        _browser = browser;
        _options = options;
        _secretServer = secretServer;
    }

    public async Task<SiteResult> RunAsync(SiteDefinition site)
    {
        var result = new SiteResult
        {
            SiteName = site.Name,
            StartedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            StepsTotal = site.Steps.Count,
            Success = true
        };

        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var defaultTimeout = site.DefaultTimeoutMs ?? _options.DefaultTimeoutMs;
        var executor = new StepExecutor(defaultTimeout, _options.FailOnHttpError, _log, _secretServer);

        IBrowserContext? context = null;
        try
        {
            context = await _browser.NewContextAsync(new BrowserNewContextOptions
            {
                IgnoreHTTPSErrors = true
            });
            var page = await context.NewPageAsync();

            _log.Info("'{Site}' — démarrage ({Count} étapes)", site.Name, site.Steps.Count);

            for (int i = 0; i < site.Steps.Count; i++)
            {
                var step = site.Steps[i];
                try
                {
                    await executor.ExecuteAsync(page, step);
                    result.StepsCompleted++;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    if (step.Optional)
                    {
                        _log.Warn("étape optionnelle #{N} ignorée ({Step}) : {Msg}", i + 1, step, ex.Message);
                        continue;
                    }

                    _log.Debug(ex, "Détail de l'échec à l'étape #{N}", i + 1);
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.FailedStepIndex = i;
                    result.FailedStep = step.ToString();
                    result.ErrorMessage = FirstLine(ex.Message);
                    await TryCaptureScreenshotAsync(page, site, result);
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (result.Success && _options.FailOnBlankPage && await PageChecks.IsBlankAsync(page))
            {
                _log.Warn("page finale blanche détectée");
                result.Success = false;
                result.FailedStep = "Contrôle final : page blanche";
                result.ErrorMessage = "La page finale est blanche (aucun contenu visible).";
                await TryCaptureScreenshotAsync(page, site, result);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {

            _log.Debug(ex, "Erreur d'infrastructure pour '{Site}'", site.Name);
            result.Success = false;
            result.ErrorMessage = FirstLine(ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (context is not null)
                await context.CloseAsync();
            sw.Stop();
            result.Duration = sw.Elapsed;
        }

        LogResult(result);
        return result;
    }

    private async Task TryCaptureScreenshotAsync(IPage page, SiteDefinition site, SiteResult result)
    {
        if (!_options.ScreenshotOnFailure)
            return;

        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_options.ArtifactsDirectory);
            var safeName = string.Join("_", site.Name.Split(Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()));
            var stamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss");
            var path = Path.Combine(_options.ArtifactsDirectory, $"{safeName}_{stamp}.png");
            await page.ScreenshotAsync(new PageScreenshotOptions { Path = path, FullPage = true });
            result.ScreenshotPath = path;
            _log.Info("capture d'écran : {Path}", path);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("échec de la capture d'écran : {Msg}", ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private void LogResult(SiteResult result)
    {
        if (result.Success)
        {
            var line = $"OK    | {result.SiteName,-45} | {result.Duration.TotalMilliseconds,6:0} ms | {result.StepsCompleted}/{result.StepsTotal} étapes";
            _results.Info(line);
            _log.Info("'{Site}' OK en {Ms:0} ms", result.SiteName, result.Duration.TotalMilliseconds);
        }
        else
        {
            var line = $"ECHEC | {result.SiteName,-45} | {result.FailureLocation} | {result.ErrorMessage}";
            _results.Error(line);
            _log.Error("'{Site}' ÉCHEC — {Where} — {Err}", result.SiteName, result.FailureLocation, result.ErrorMessage);
        }
    }

    private static string FirstLine(string? s)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s))
            return "(erreur inconnue)";
        var idx = s.IndexOf('\n');
        return (idx >= 0 ? s[..idx] : s).Trim();
    }
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Program.cs
################################################################################

using Microsoft.Playwright;
using NLog;
using NLog.Extensions.Logging;
using WebLoginMonitor.Services;

var baseDir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;

if (args.Contains("--install"))
{
    return Microsoft.Playwright.Program.Main(["install", "chromium"]);
}

var configuration = ConfigLoader.BuildConfiguration(baseDir);
LogManager.Configuration = new NLogLoggingConfiguration(configuration.GetSection("NLog"));
var log = LogManager.GetCurrentClassLogger();

int exitCode = 0;
SecretServerClient? secretServer = null;
try
{
    var options = ConfigLoader.LoadOptions(configuration, baseDir);
    var sites = ConfigLoader.LoadSites(options.SitesFile);

    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(options.SecretServer.BaseUrl))
        secretServer = new SecretServerClient(options.SecretServer, LogManager.GetLogger("SecretServer"));

    var onlyArg = args.FirstOrDefault(a => a.StartsWith("--only=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
    var only = onlyArg?["--only=".Length..];

    var active = sites
        .Where(s => s.Enabled)
        .Where(s => only is null || s.Name.Contains(only, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        .ToList();

    if (active.Count == 0)
    {
        log.Warn("Aucun site actif à tester (vérifiez 'enabled' dans {File}).", options.SitesFile);
        return 0;
    }

    log.Info("=== WebLoginMonitor — {Count} site(s) — {Browser} (headless={Headless}) ===",
        active.Count, options.Browser, options.Headless);

    using var playwright = await Playwright.CreateAsync();
    var launchOptions = new BrowserTypeLaunchOptions
    {
        Headless = options.Headless,
        SlowMo = options.SlowMoMs
    };

    IBrowserType browserType;
    switch (options.Browser.ToLowerInvariant())
    {
        case "firefox": browserType = playwright.Firefox; break;
        case "webkit": browserType = playwright.Webkit; break;
        case "edge" or "msedge": browserType = playwright.Chromium; launchOptions.Channel = "msedge"; break;
        case "chrome": browserType = playwright.Chromium; launchOptions.Channel = "chrome"; break;
        default: browserType = playwright.Chromium; break;
    }

    IBrowser browser;
    try
    {
        browser = await browserType.LaunchAsync(launchOptions);
    }
    catch (PlaywrightException ex) when (
        ex.Message.Contains("Executable doesn't exist", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        ex.Message.Contains("is not found", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    {
        log.Fatal("Navigateur '{Browser}' introuvable. Chromium/Firefox/WebKit : `dotnet run --project src/WebLoginMonitor -- --install`. " +
                  "Edge/Chrome : vérifiez qu'il est installé sur la machine.", options.Browser);
        log.Debug(ex, "Détail");
        return 2;
    }

    var runner = new SiteRunner(browser, options, secretServer);
    var gate = new SemaphoreSlim(Math.Max(1, options.MaxParallelism));

    var tasks = active.Select(async site =>
    {
        await gate.WaitAsync();
        try { return await runner.RunAsync(site); }
        finally { gate.Release(); }
    });

    var results = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
    await browser.CloseAsync();

    var failures = results.Count(r => !r.Success);
    log.Info("=== Terminé : {Ok}/{Total} OK, {Fail} échec(s) ===",
        results.Length - failures, results.Length, failures);

    var notifier = new NotificationService(options.Email);
    await notifier.SendIfNeededAsync(results);

    exitCode = failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    log.Fatal(ex, "Erreur fatale du monitoring.");
    exitCode = 3;
}
finally
{
    secretServer?.Dispose();
    LogManager.Shutdown();
}

return exitCode;
